description: Figure 3(a) illustrates the Bit-per-Character (BPC) on a validation dataset during the training phase for the SMoE Routing Policy, plotted against Training Steps on a logarithmic x-axis scaled in units of 10³, ranging from 0 to 50. The y-axis represents BPC with a linear scale, ranging from 1.2 to 2.2. The plot contains two lines: a black solid line with circular markers labeled “SMoE Validating,” which starts at approximately 2.2 BPC and decreases to about 1.2 BPC; and a magenta dashed line with circular markers labeled “SimSMoE Validating,” which starts at approximately 2.2 BPC and decreases to about 1.2 BPC, closely following the black line throughout the training steps.
